town_description: Pushkar is a small holy town in Ajmer district, Rajasthan, built around the sacred Pushkar Lake with over 500 temples. It is one of the five sacred pilgrimage places for Hindus and hosts the famous Pushkar Camel Fair each November.

travel.airport: Jaipur International Airport, about 150 km away.
travel.road: About 15 km northwest of Ajmer via NH-48/NH-58; local buses and taxis run from Ajmer.

visitor_information.best_time: November to February; the Pushkar Fair around Kartik Poornima is the peak season.
